steps.action: Every Target state reads as the corrected guide describes it
steps.actual: Fixed Contract target "NDA" reads "Converting a request of this type creates a contract of the NDA type.". Fixed Matter target "Ind template type IND81T2F" reads "Converting a request of this type creates a matter of the Ind template type IND81T2F type.". Module-only "Matter" reads "Converting a request of this type creates a matter; the reviewer picks the matter type at conversion.", so the reviewer picks the type. No target reads "Converting a request of this type creates no record. It is answered in the thread and resolved there.", which is the sentence the corrected guide now quotes.

steps.action: A No target Request is resolved in the thread rather than converted
steps.actual: R-30 came from the No target form; its Request page reads Converts to "No target" and Triage offers ["Convert to contract","Convert to matter","Resolve request without converting"]. Resolving it in the thread ("Resolve R-30 without converting | Explain why this request can be closed without creating a contract or matter. | Resolution note (required) | This goes on the request's thread, an") left the Request at status "resolved" with no Contract or Matter created — the disposition the corrected guide describes.

steps.action: Archiving an in-use request type asks for a replacement and Restore does not reverse it
